intro: Krazek has mended the pot and added a second steam whistle, plus a new chopper in the base made to cut through leg bones. The pot now has to go back to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were gone I fixed the pot you brought me. I even added an extra steam whistle, and look! There's a new chopper at the bottom that'll cut through leg bones!
Yes yes, Krazek's Crock Pot is a 100% cook pleaser! I'm sure its owner will be satisfied.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Did you make it to Booty Bay? Did the goblin Krazek fix my pot??

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's fixed! This is great, now I can get dinner started! Thanks so much, friend.

I hope you were okay in Booty Bay. That place can get pretty rough, and... I heard rumors that the goblins will sometimes drag drunk sailors to their slave boats and take them to who-knows-where... To do who-knows-what...
